question: For the six inhabited continents (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America), compute total estimated population, total land area in million km² using spheroid area, and population density in people per km². Return only continents with at least 1,000,000 km² of land area and a density above 20 people/km², ordered by density descending.
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT continent, pop_est, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2 FROM countries WHERE continent IN ('Africa','Asia','Europe','North America','Oceania','South America') AND pop_est > 0 AND geometry IS NOT NULL) SELECT continent, SUM(pop_est) AS total_pop, ROUND(SUM(area_km2) / 1000000.0, 2) AS total_area_mkm2, ROUND(SUM(pop_est) / SUM(area_km2), 1) AS density_per_km2 FROM c GROUP BY continent HAVING SUM(area_km2) >= 1000000 AND SUM(pop_est) / SUM(area_km2) > 20 ORDER BY density_per_km2 DESC, continent;

question: For features classified as River, list names that are represented by at least 2 line segments and have a total spheroid length greater than 1,000 km. Return the segment count, total length in km, and maximum scalerank, ordered by total length descending.
sql: SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS segment_count, ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 1) AS total_length_km, MAX(scalerank) AS max_scalerank FROM rivers WHERE feature_class = 'River' AND geometry IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0 > 1000 ORDER BY total_length_km DESC, name LIMIT 20;

question: For each continent, count countries whose polygon intersects at least one River feature with scalerank 3 or lower, and compute the average estimated population of those countries. Return only continents with at least 2 such countries, ordered by count descending.
sql: WITH river_countries AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.iso_a3, c.continent, c.pop_est FROM countries c WHERE c.geometry IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rivers r WHERE r.feature_class = 'River' AND r.scalerank <= 3 AND r.geometry IS NOT NULL AND ST_Intersects(c.geometry, r.geometry))) SELECT continent, COUNT(*) AS countries_with_major_rivers, ROUND(AVG(pop_est), 0) AS avg_pop_est FROM river_countries GROUP BY continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY countries_with_major_rivers DESC, continent;

question: For each river feature class, identify the single feature with the greatest spheroid length. If there is a tie, prefer the smaller scalerank, then the alphabetically first name. Return feature class, name, scalerank, and length in km.
sql: SELECT feature_class, name, scalerank, ROUND(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS length_km FROM rivers WHERE geometry IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY feature_class ORDER BY ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) DESC, scalerank ASC, name ASC) = 1 ORDER BY feature_class;

question: Among countries with population above 10 million and positive GDP, classify each country by population density: under 50 people/km², 50–200 people/km², or 200+ people/km². For each continent and density band, return the country count and average GDP per capita in USD, keeping only groups with at least 3 countries.
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT continent, pop_est, gdp_md, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2 FROM countries WHERE pop_est > 10000000 AND gdp_md > 0 AND geometry IS NOT NULL), classified AS (SELECT continent, pop_est, gdp_md, CASE WHEN pop_est / area_km2 < 50 THEN 'under 50/km2' WHEN pop_est / area_km2 < 200 THEN '50-200/km2' ELSE '200+/km2' END AS density_band FROM c) SELECT continent, density_band, COUNT(*) AS country_count, ROUND(AVG(gdp_md * 1000000.0 / pop_est), 0) AS avg_gdp_per_capita_usd FROM classified GROUP BY continent, density_band HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY continent, density_band;

question: Find all river and lake-centerline features within 100 km of longitude 127.1144, latitude 72.4684 (the centroid of the Bykovskaya Protoka sample). Use a metric CRS and return feature name, feature class, scalerank, and distance in km, ordered by distance.
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_Point(127.1144, 72.4684), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32652', always_xy := true) AS geom), rivers_utm AS (SELECT name, feature_class, scalerank, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32652', always_xy := true) AS geom FROM rivers WHERE geometry IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.name, r.feature_class, r.scalerank, ROUND(ST_Distance(r.geom, t.geom) / 1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM rivers_utm r, target t WHERE ST_Distance(r.geom, t.geom) <= 100000 ORDER BY distance_km, r.name, r.feature_class LIMIT 20;
